隔海的岛屿州立公园可安排步行、海湾眺望与移民历史参观。它不在 Belvedere: An island state park for walks, bay views and immigration history. It is outside Belvedere: take a ferry from nearby Tiburon and check sailings, the return trip and museum access before planning an island visit.
横跨半岛山坡的开放空间，以海湾视野、岩石和稀有植物著称；Phyllis Ellm: An open-space preserve across the peninsula hills, known for bay views, rocks and rare plants. Choose a route such as the Phyllis Ellman loop to suit your fitness. Expect elevation gain and no toilets; leash dogs. The celebrated Tiburon mariposa lily is a spring attraction, not a fall bloom promise.
Fairfax 山边的林地与溪谷步道，Cascade Falls 是有水时的看点: Woodland and creek trails in the hills outside Fairfax, with Cascade Falls when water is flowing. Fall water flow is not guaranteed. Residential-street access has limited parking and no toilets; stay on designated trails and leash dogs throughout.
Larkspur 西侧的红木溪谷，沿林荫步道寻找 Dawn Falls；瀑布受雨: A redwood canyon west of Larkspur with shaded trails toward Dawn Falls. Water flow depends on rainfall, so photos do not establish current conditions. Some approaches use residential streets and there are no public toilets; check gradients and parking restrictions.
城外著名的老生海岸红木林，可按时间选择主步道短环线。自驾停车或接驳车均应提前安排: The famous old-growth coast-redwood forest outside town offers shorter loops along the main trail. Arrange parking or shuttle reservations in advance. Mobile service is limited in the valley, so save confirmations and return details before arriving.
DeLong Avenue 的历史住宅里收藏本地照片、服饰、工具与生活物件，适合: A historic house on DeLong Avenue displays local photographs, clothing, tools and everyday objects, making a useful Old Town stop. The official visitor listing shows free admission on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays from noon to 4 pm; check for changes before visiting.
镇边的林地公园也是通往 Phoenix Lake 的入口，适合把野餐与短步行分开: A wooded town park and gateway toward Phoenix Lake, suitable for a picnic and a separate short walk. The lake route continues into Marin Water watershed land; check watershed access and trail notices rather than applying town-park rules to the entire route.
Millennium Playground 把小火车、车站和本镇建筑意象做成儿童: Millennium Playground uses trains, a depot and local-building themes in a children’s play area, beside Elders Garden and sports fields. It is a useful family stop when a full day of hiking is too much; field and picnic reservations follow town arrangements.
市中心的传教站历史参观点与现役教堂相邻，可了解 San Rafael 城名背后的: A mission-history stop beside an active downtown church introduces the history behind San Rafael’s name. Distinguish visitor areas from worship spaces and check parish arrangements for opening, tours and services.
位于金门大桥北侧 Fort Baker，以0–8岁儿童的动手探索和户外游玩为主，: At Fort Baker north of the Golden Gate Bridge, this hands-on and outdoor museum focuses on ages 0–8 and can fill a relaxed half day. It is in national-park land near Sausalito. General visits require admission; check tickets for accompanying adults too.
黑马雕像、海湾边长椅与原铁路走廊构成轻松散步起点；可按体力沿 Old Rail: A bronze horse, bay-side benches and a former rail corridor make a relaxed starting point for an out-and-back walk on the Old Rail Trail. Good for waterfront views and a rest; it is not a swimming-beach recommendation or a guarantee of full-route accessibility.
城东约620英亩的山地开放空间，以草坡、树林与未铺装步道为主，适合想从湿地换到山: About 620 acres of hills, woodland and unpaved trails on the east side of town offer a change from wetland walks. General access is sunrise to sunset, subject to weather, fire-risk and seasonal closures; check city notices first.
Tubbs Lane 上的地热喷泉园区，是 Calistoga 周边有辨识度的自: The geothermal geyser grounds on Tubbs Lane are a distinctive attraction near Calistoga and can be paired with a picnic. Admission is charged. Eruptions are natural, so do not assume one immediately on arrival or a fixed interval; check current tickets and access.
First Street 的室内市集把餐饮、食品和河岸街区短逛串在一起，适合分头: This First Street market combines food vendors with a short river-district visit, useful when a group wants different meals. Each merchant sets its own hours and prices; the building’s hours do not mean every vendor is open.
位于 St. Helena 以北的历史水力磨坊，巨型水轮与制粉示范展现葡萄酒之外: A historic water-powered mill north of St. Helena, with a large wheel and milling demonstrations showing the valley’s grain-farming past. Check regular weekend visits separately from special-event tickets or charges; this highway-side site is not a downtown walking stop.
55 Presidents Circle 的博物馆适合把艺术与地方历史放进酒乡半: The museum at 55 Presidents Circle combines art and local history for a wine-country half day, with regular Wednesday–Sunday opening. This is NVMY, not The MAC in St. Helena; check exhibitions and admission for the correct campus.
沿 Russian River 西岸的步道串起城边河岸景观，铺装段适合短程来回步: Trails along the west bank of the Russian River offer views on the town’s edge, with a paved section suited to shorter out-and-back walks. Bring drinking water. There are no lifeguards; a riverside visit is not a swimming recommendation, and dogs must be leashed.
本镇的社区球场公园适合居民散步与运动，市府曾与本地棒球队合作整修球场。导航一定加: A local park for neighborhood walks and sports, with ballfields improved through a city and local-baseball partnership. Include Cotati in navigation: this is not Helen Putnam Regional Park near Petaluma or a large hillside hiking destination.
3 North Street 的社区棚亭是2026年周六农夫市集的新址，可把本地: The community pavilion at 3 North Street is the Saturday farmers market’s new 2026 home, pairing local food shopping with a downtown walk. The market is not daily: check its seasonal Saturday 8:30 am–noon schedule. The Tuesday season ended September 29.
城外 Adobe Road 的土坯庄园遗址可了解19世纪牧场与农业历史，与市中心: The adobe ranch site outside town introduces 19th-century ranching and agriculture, contrasting with downtown’s Victorian streets. Check admission and building hours. It requires a drive from downtown rather than serving as the next stop on a neighborhood walk.
城东丘陵的草地、橡树与步道，另有18洞飞盘高尔夫场。适合在餐饮或城市活动之外留一: Grassland, oaks and trails in the hills east of town, plus an 18-hole disc-golf course. A useful outdoor break from town activities; bring water and choose gradients carefully. Spring-wildflower publicity does not describe November conditions.
历史铁路街区保留石砌建筑与老城氛围，适合找咖啡、古董和餐饮，再在车站周边短走。这: The historic railroad district offers stone buildings, old-town atmosphere, cafés, antiques and restaurants around the depot area. It is a walkable neighborhood, not an attraction ticket that includes a train ride; merchants keep individual hours.
市府维护的 Laguna de Santa Rosa 湿地保护空间，可用短步行观: City-maintained wetland space along the Laguna de Santa Rosa for short walks and seasonal observations. Check open paths and standing water. Respect wetland, seasonal-connection and nearby private-property boundaries; dry year-round passage is not guaranteed.
Sonoma 东侧的公园将葡萄园景观、林地步道与野餐空间放在一起，公众可免费进入: East of Sonoma, this park combines vineyard views, woodland trails and picnic space, with free public park entry. Wine tasting, food and private events are separate. Check current opening and trail conditions before a hillside walk.
Windsor 东侧有池塘、橡树林与多条山坡步道；Three Lakes 段较平: Ponds, oak woodland and hillside trails on Windsor’s east side. Three Lakes is gentler while routes such as Alta Vista climb. Choose a short loop to suit your fitness, leash dogs, and check parking charges and trail conditions before leaving.
市区西侧的盐沼、海岸与低丘，适合骑行、散步和观察水鸟，园内道路与步道可按距离折返: Marsh, shoreline and low hills west of town offer cycling, walking and waterbird observation, with routes that can be shortened by turning back. Vehicle entry is charged and dogs must be leashed; birding and bay views do not imply safe swimming.
Dixon 以南约10英里的季节性池塘草原保护区，可走指定自导览环线了解稀有栖地: A vernal-pool grassland preserve roughly 10 miles south of Dixon, with a designated self-guided loop introducing rare habitat. Public-area hours are normally 9 am–5 pm. Spring tours and blooms do not apply to fall. Pets are prohibited and drinking water is unavailable.
Fairfield 管理的山地公园，适合把橡树林与丘陵步道作为半天户外活动。出发: A city-managed hillside park for oak woodland and a half day on trails. Use the city’s park page to check passes, closures and route difficulty before leaving; city ownership does not mean every form of access is free.
Rio Vista 南侧 Sacramento River 河岸的野餐、露营与船: A Sacramento River site south of Rio Vista for picnics, camping and boat launching. The county prohibits swimming because of strong currents and steep drop-offs. Day-use construction and boat-ramp access may change; read park-status notices first.
Highway 12 沿线的历史电气铁路博物馆，可结合车辆展览与指定列车班次。虽: A historic electric-railway museum on Highway 12, combining vehicle displays with scheduled train trips. Its Suisun City mailing address is outside the urban area. Check regular weekend tickets, special events and departures separately rather than looking for an entrance downtown.
Peña Adobe Road 的大型湖区公园，有湖畔步行和延伸到山坡的户外路线: A large park on Peña Adobe Road with lakeside walking and routes extending into the hills. Choose a flatter short section or a climb to suit the group, and check parking and hours separately. A lake-view recommendation is not a swimming recommendation.
Mare Island 西侧约4英里的滨湾步道，可看 San Pablo Bay: An approximately four-mile bay-side trail on western Mare Island with San Pablo Bay and distant-mountain views. Plan it separately from the island’s historic district and check entrances and restrictions. This recommendation covers a public outdoor route, not guaranteed access to shipyard buildings or museums.
